name: My Pet Merchant
original_name: マイペットマーチャント
source:
12th episode in My pet Ragnarok series.
The skies turn red, and men get insane with lust. Female merchant Seta falls victim to this hunt.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我的宠物仙境传说系列第12集。
天空变红，人们因欲望而疯狂。女商人瑟塔成为这次狩猎的受害者。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
